text.en: Memorandum on the Constitution of the Dominion

references: issued under the authority of the Indian Independence Act 1947 with effect from the appointed day

subject.en: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and the circumstances of its foundation — for general information

text.en: Pakistan, officially the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, is a country in South Asia. Islamabad is the nation's capital, while Karachi is its largest city and financial centre. It shares land borders with India to the east; Afghanistan to the west; Iran to the south-west; and China to the north-east, and is bounded by the Arabian Sea on the south.

Pakistan achieved independence on the 14th August 1947 following the partition of British India into two separate Dominions. The nation was founded following the Pakistan Movement, which sought a homeland for the Muslims of British India after the All-India Muslim League's electoral victories in 1946.

Muhammad Ali Jinnah, leader of the Muslim League, has assumed office as the first Governor-General and is recognised as the founding figure of the nation. All Heads of Offices shall arrange for the display of this Memorandum at every public office.

designation.en: for Press Information Officer, Government of Pakistan
